definitions.gloss: paganism; a religion different from one's own
definitions.explanation: A religion or faith other than the one regarded as standard by the speaker. From the standpoint of a given religion, it labels other belief systems, often with a historical or judgmental connotation.

examples.japanese: {異教|いきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: To believe in a pagan god.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{異教|いきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風習|ふうしゅう}→風習：05826_fuushuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Old pagan customs remain in that region.

examples.japanese: ⟦{布教|ふきょう}→布教：15286_fukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{過程|かてい}→過程：02621_katei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{異教|いきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{儀式|ぎしき}→儀式：00071_gishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}される→禁止する：22145_kinshisuru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In the course of proselytizing, pagan rituals were sometimes prohibited.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{異|い}→異：01925_i⟧ (different) + {教|きょう} (religion, teaching). Labels a religion other than one's own, often in historical or religious-conflict contexts. Refers to the belief system itself; a follower of it is an ⟦{異教徒|いきょうと}→異教徒：29844_ikyouto⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異教|いきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧: a pagan god
- {異教|いきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風習|ふうしゅう}→風習：05826_fuushuu⟧: pagan customs
- {異教|いきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧: to follow a different religion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{異教徒|いきょうと}→異教徒：29844_ikyouto⟧: pagan; nonbeliever — the person, not the belief system
- ⟦{邪教|じゃきょう}→邪教：29856_jakyou⟧: evil cult; heretical religion — explicitly condemns the religion as wicked
